name: Serpstat
summary: SEO platform covering keyword research, competitor analysis, rank tracking, site audit and backlink data, cheaper on annual billing, with a 7-day trial that takes a card and auto-renews.
best_for: solo SEOs and small in-house teams who want the whole workflow (keywords, rankings, audit, competitors) under one subscription at roughly a third of what the incumbents charge, and who will judge the data on their own market during the trial
skip_if: your work depends on deep backlink analysis, since the 10,000 results per report ceiling does not move no matter which tier you buy; or you need more than three seats, because seats are not sold separately and the next tier roughly doubles the bill
honest_knock: The thing you are actually buying is data coverage, and that is the one thing you cannot verify: Serpstat's own published figures do not agree with each other. Re-read on 24 July 2026, their homepage says 529 billion backlinks, their data hub says 1.1 trillion, and their backlinks page says 1.7 trillion in the prose while its own spec block on that same page says 1.1 trillion. The keyword count reads 8.62 billion on one page and 7.46 billion on another. That is not evidence the data is thin; it is evidence that these numbers cannot serve as a basis for your decision. Judge it on your own searches during the trial instead. Two other things to weigh. Backlink reports are capped at 10,000 results per report on Team, Team x2 and Agency alike, so paying from $129 to $499 buys more of everything except a deeper backlink report. And 'maximum pages to scan' in a single crawl (5,000 / 25,000 / 50,000) is a far smaller number than the monthly 'pages to audit' allowance it sits next to.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (2026-07-24, read on their own pricing page) Four plans, and the page opens on the annual view — so the first number you see is not the month-to-month price. Individual $69/month, or $50 on annual billing. Team $129, or $100 annually. Team x2 $209, or $169. Agency $499, or $410. There is a hidden middle step: two dropdowns inside the Team column (position checks 50,000 or 99,999, API credits 200,000 or 400,000) move Team to $169/month monthly or $135 annually, so Team is really three price points. Seats are capped rather than sold: Individual is single-user, Team 3, Team x2 6, Agency 30, and no per-seat price is published anywhere — a fourth user means the next tier. The limits matter more than the prices: 100 searches a day on Individual (500 / 1,000 / 5,000 above it), export rows 50,000 a month, and no API at all on the entry plan. The 7-day trial takes a card, charges $1 to verify, turns on auto-renewal and bills the plan after seven days unless you cancel. Re-verified 2026-08-26: the four annual prices are unchanged, and the page now heads the table with 'save up to 27% with annual discount' and prints the saving per plan — $228, $348, $484 and $1,068 a year. That is the arithmetic that turns $50, $100, $169 and $410 back into $69, $129, $209 and $499, which matters because the monthly column itself is not in the page's HTML at all; only the annual one renders. The comparison table still carries the two-value Team column (position checks 50,000 or 99,999, API credits 200,000 or 400,000), so the hidden middle step is still there, but its price is printed nowhere on the page today. Three limits worth reading before anyone picks Individual: Site Audit does no JavaScript rendering on that plan, it scans at most 5,000 pages, and its data retention figure is 2 where Team gets 10 and Agency 100. Re-verified 2026-09-19 on the same page: the four annual figures, the four annual savings and the two-value Team column are all unchanged, as are the seat caps of 1, 3, 6 and 30 and the seven-day trial with its $1 card verification and automatic renewal. What is new on the page is what the plans now sell rather than what they cost — Team upward advertises a ChatGPT and Claude integration over MCP and an AI Overview brand-opportunities report, and a separate LLM Brand Monitor is promoted underneath the plans with its own free scan and no price attached to it. Re-verified 20 November 2026: the four annual prices ($50, $100, $169 and $410), the seat caps of 1, 3, 6 and 30 and the seven-day trial with its $1 card verification and automatic renewal are unchanged. The printed saving on Team x2 now reads $480 a year instead of $484, which matches $209 a month exactly. AI Visibility, the renamed LLM Brand Monitor, is now included with Team, Team x2 and Agency at no extra cost: 1,500 checks a month on Team and Team x2 and 3,000 on Agency, with extra checks at $20 per 1,000 and a minimum top-up of $40. A Black Friday offer runs from 23 to 30 November 2026: 20% off monthly plans and up to 36% saved on annual billing, for the first billing period only, after which the plan renews at the standard price.

compare_with.name: SE Ranking
compare_with.why: the closest self-serve rival on price and scope: both sell the full workflow well under what the incumbents charge, so the decision comes down to which one's data holds up on your own market and how each counts its limits. Compare the units carefully: a daily allowance and a monthly stock are not the same number, and both vendors mix them. Verify both current price lists yourself.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Serpstat in the 7-day Individual trial that we started with our card and a $1 verification. Keyword, domain and audit results came within seconds, but the trial shows at most 2,000 backlinks per report and has no API or AI Visibility. Cancelling is one dialog, but it ends the trial and locks most tools at once. Account and start: we created the account and started the 7-day Individual trial, monthly, with his own card and a $1 verification. Our AI assistant ran the test in its own tab on 19 November 2026 from about 18:38 to 18:46 CET. The interface was in English. My account showed Individual Trial Global (Active until 2026-11-26) and Automatic renewal On. Core action, SEO research: keyword research for coffee grinder on google.com gave Volume 480, PPC competition 46, CPC 0.52 and KW. difficulty 25/100 within about 6 seconds; the search bar at the top did nothing, only the sidebar route Keyword research, Overview worked. Domain analysis of wikipedia.org gave Visibility score 93, Backlinks 24.4M and Referring domains 158.1K within about 8 seconds. Backlink analysis refused wikipedia.org: This information is currently unavailable for domains with a large backlink profile. For seranking.com the list read of 2,000 (total: 212,514), so the trial shows at most 2,000 backlinks. A site audit of example.org scanned 1 page in about 15 seconds: SDO score 84, High priority 4, Medium 2, Low 2. The rank tracker project stayed a draft without a search region. AI Visibility is not included in your plan. The MCP page offers 63 SEO tools for Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini through OAuth; nothing was connected. Trial limits: Credits for sites, keywords and links analysis 100/100, Export rows 1,000/1,000, Projects 5/5, Users 0/1, API credits 0/0 with API is unavailable for your plan. Plans and trial: no amount is shown in the app; the dossier gives Individual at $69 a month. Bills shows Recurring Billing on and a Payment history with no rows, so the $1 verification does not show in the app. The card expires 12/2026. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done the same day: My account, Automatic renewal On, Change (or the Recurring Billing switch). The dialog: Are you sure you want to end your trial? Once auto-payment is cancelled, most reports and tools will be locked. You still have 7 days of trial left. You can cancel auto-payment any time before November 26. End my trial was clicked. After a reload My account showed Plan Registered user and Automatic renewal Off. No reason form, no retention offer, no password and no mail to support. There is no screenshot of the result because it shows the account e-mail. Not tested: team use with more users, real rank positions, export, branded reports, the API, connecting the MCP and AI Visibility. Clean up: the test project example.org with one audit and an empty rank tracker project stays; the trial has ended. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The search bar at the top did nothing; only the sidebar route worked. Backlink analysis refuses very large domains. The $1 verification and the renewal amount do not show anywhere in the app.

vendor_mcp.what: Two builds of the same server: a hosted HTTP endpoint you authorise once with OAuth and use from web, desktop and mobile, or a local Node.js STDIO build where the API token never leaves your machine and you pick which tool groups to load. 63 SEO tools — keyword research, competitor gaps, backlink audits, site audits and rank tracking.
vendor_mcp.plan: Team plan and above. Their own plan comparison lists "API, ChatGPT and Claude Integration (MCP)" as a Team feature and marks API access as absent on the Individual plan below it. Use is metered: every query spends Serpstat API credits at standard API pricing — 100 credits for 100 domain keywords, 5 for a backlinks summary. The 7-day trial includes full API access.
vendor_mcp.note: The vendor's own MCP server, from our MCP research; it works with your own account at the vendor.
